collect_env_info: collect and print system environment info including CUDA, PyTorch, GPUs, and VISSL dependencies
collect_torch_env: collect and return PyTorch configuration details including version and debug build status
collect_gpus_info: collect GPU availability, device names, CUDA_HOME, and TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST environment settings
collect_dep_env: collect installed dependency versions for torchvision, hydra, classy_vision, tensorboard, apex, and cv2
collect_cpu_info: collect and format system CPU information by parsing lscpu output into a tabulated string
